briefs.title: Customer asks whether their kettle is recalled
briefs.text: A customer opens the website chat widget: 'Hi, I bought a BrightBrew 2L kettle last March. Is it part of the recall and what do I do? I do not have the receipt.' The assistant may look up a serial number or a purchase month against the recall lot table, explain the options in the published recall policy (refund, replacement, free courier return), and - only if the customer confirms - request a prepaid return label from the existing label endpoint. Each conversation concerns exactly one customer; the next thing the assistant does depends on what the customer says next. Customers often answer a different question than the one asked, switch topic, or ask about a second appliance.

facts.side_effects: one prepaid label on explicit customer confirmation
facts.volume: about 900 chats per day in the first week

briefs.title: Nightly regulator filing for newly confirmed lots
briefs.text: Each night, for every lot that has been newly marked 'confirmed affected' in the recall register, produce the jurisdiction-specific notification (EU Safety Gate form, UK OPSS form, US CPSC-style Section 15(b) report). The form templates and mandatory fields are published by the regulators and change only a few times a year. Steps are always the same: pull lot and product data, fill the template for each jurisdiction where the lot was sold, validate mandatory fields, queue for legal sign-off, and submit after approval is recorded. Between 5 and 40 lots per night; a missing mandatory field must stop that lot's filing and be reported.

facts.side_effects: external regulator submission after human approval

briefs.title: Triage retailer replies to recall notices
briefs.text: Retailers answer the recall notice by email in free text - roughly 3,000 replies in the first week. Each reply must be labelled with exactly one of: acknowledged, stock_already_sold, disputes_scope, needs_pickup, other - and then placed in one of four work queues (compliance desk, logistics desk, category manager, general inbox) according to a fixed routing table. Replies that dispute the scope of the recall go to the category manager. Replies are independent of each other; nothing a reply says changes how the next one is handled.

facts.who_decides_next_step: a fixed routing table keyed by label
facts.side_effects: message is placed in a queue

briefs.title: Trace a supplier contamination report to finished-goods lots
briefs.text: A heating-element supplier reports that coating batch HC-88 may be contaminated. The batch can appear in 14 SKUs sold under 3 private labels. Bills of materials differ between the two ERP systems, two distributors re-labelled lots, and some goods-receipt records only say 'element, std'. Determine which finished-goods lots might contain batch HC-88, give evidence and a confidence for each lot, and list the lots that need physical verification. Which record to query next depends on what the previous query revealed (a missing BOM line leads to goods-receipt records, which may lead to a distributor re-label table, and so on). Nobody can write the query sequence in advance, and the investigator must judge when the evidence is sufficient to stop.

facts.side_effects: none (read-only investigation); output is a proposed lot list
facts.volume: one investigation per supplier report; a handful per month

steps.name: identify_affected_lots
steps.description: From the supplier report determine which finished-goods lots may contain the contaminated element coating. Evidence is spread over two ERPs, goods-receipt records and distributor re-label tables.

steps.name: notify_regulators
steps.description: Render and submit the jurisdiction-specific recall notification for each confirmed lot after legal approval is recorded. Templates and mandatory fields are published by regulators.

facts.side_effects: external regulator submission after human approval

steps.name: notify_retailers_and_customers
steps.description: Send the approved recall notice to every retailer and registered customer who received an affected lot, using the contact list export and the approved text per locale.

steps.name: quarantine_inventory
steps.description: Place all stock of the affected lots on hold in every warehouse so it cannot be picked or shipped.

facts.side_effects: inventory state change in the warehouse system

steps.name: schedule_returns
steps.description: Assign carrier pickups for returned units within carrier capacity and customer time windows.

steps.name: track_completion
steps.description: Reconcile returned, destroyed and outstanding unit counts per lot against units shipped and report completion percentage.

steps.name: executive_status
steps.description: Produce the one-page weekly status for the executive committee from the reconciled counts and the regulator filing receipts.
